notes.note: Bounded create-admission review: default-store createLocked now uses the existing isSafePathSegment predicate before duplicate lookup or staged writes. Reviewed the public route guard, alias resolution, transaction owner, accepted-ID fixtures and real-adapter rejection tests. Knowledge guide documents the ASCII single-segment constraint and MISSING_EVIDENCE; design retains historical route rationale with a current clarification. Store/index ownership, graph snapshot IDs, generated UUID flows, lookup aliases, transaction recovery and example UI/API journeys remain accurate. The route source delta is comment-only. Focused adapter suites passed 125 tests; removing the guard failed all seven regression cases, restoration passed 39. This note covers this bounded delta, not a new provider, device, historical probe or whole-document qualification.
